context.run: issue run — invoked pointed at one work/Issue folder (define-task's staged fix), not a scenario
context.issue: order grand total rounds half-down; fix PriceHelper.round to half-up and let OrderService.calcGrandTotal use it
context.note: There is no scenario.html for this run — status is read straight from the task files. The project also has an unrelated scenario queue (01-Setup/ + 02-Backlog/) that this run must NOT touch.

evals.title: Issue run builds its queue from the pointed-at folder
evals.prompt: Run execute-issue for the invocation above. All tasks start pending.
expectations: The queue is built from work/Issue/03-order-total-rounding/Backlog/ — the folder the run was pointed at
The scenario queue (01-Setup/ + 02-Backlog/) is NOT drained by this run and its tasks are not touched
00-check-test is picked first — the only task with no depends_on
The same loop applies: topmost runnable pending task whose depends_on are all done (00 → 01/02 → 03 → 04)
03-round-half-up-code is not picked until both 01 and 02 are done

evals.title: 00-check-test is the baseline gate
evals.prompt: 00-check-test is dispatched. Its command runs the project's existing full suite + api-test suite. acceptance = all green (baseline).
expectations: It runs the existing suites and expects all green BEFORE any change is made
If the baseline is already red → halt and ask the user; new code on a broken baseline makes later failures impossible to attribute
If all green → 00-check-test done, the loop proceeds to 01/02
No production code is written for this task — it is run-only

evals.title: Same dispatch + RED-is-PASS as the scenario run
evals.prompt: 01-round-half-up-boundary-test (type unit-test) is dispatched. No handler exists at agent-skill/unit-test/. The engineer writes the test and runs command; it fails because half-up rounding isn't implemented yet. acceptance = red.
expectations: Dispatched to agent-skill/default-tdd — no type-specific handler for unit-test
The red result matches acceptance 'red' → this is a PASS, 01 set to done
execute-issue does not write the test or code itself — the engineer agent does
The loop does not try to fix the red — the paired code task 03 turns it green

evals.title: A halt tells the user WITHOUT refreshing a report
evals.prompt: 03-round-half-up-code is dispatched but after implementation tests 01/02 are still red. acceptance = green.
expectations: Result (red) ≠ acceptance (green) → FAILURE; 03 set to failed and the loop halts
The user is told and the run waits for their decision — downstream 04-regression depends on 03
generate-report is NOT called and no scenario.html is written — an issue run has no report; status is read from the task files
The loop does not barrel ahead to any other task

evals.title: DRAINED ends the run — no Stage 5 handoff
evals.prompt: 01, 02, 03 are done; 04-regression is dispatched, runs the full suite + api-test suite, and is green. No pending tasks remain in the folder.
expectations: 04-regression runs the whole suite + api-test as its command and confirms all green — it is the run's regression gate
No pending tasks remain → DRAINED, and the run ends here
It reports the result plus the self-learn items recorded this run, then stops
It does NOT hand off to Stage 5 / api-test — the regression task already ran the api-test suite; there is no next stage for an issue run
generate-report is NOT called at the DRAINED pause either
